test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

We need to __focus in__ finding a sustainable solution.
solution:
The correct answer is '**focus on**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct preposition to use with the verb "**focus**" is "**on**."
 
• The phrase "**focus on**" is used to refer to concentrating or giving attention to a particular subject or task.
